_comment: Advisory/NVD source registry for the TOP-UP snapshot cohort (2026-10-17), the 2 CVE IDs added by D-035. This cohort is SEPARATE from the frozen 30-CVE snapshot in data/public-snapshot/ (2026-10-11, D-026); nothing here backdates into that manifest.
_provenance: All bytes listed below were already fetched in the step-1 verification session of 2026-10-17 and are persisted in experiments/topup-2026-10-17/sources/ (see experiments/topup-2026-10-17/manifest.md). This build step copies them VERBATIM (sha256 re-checked before and after the copy) and derives cpe.json from the saved nvd.json. No new network fetch was needed; the fetch timestamps below are the step-1 fetch timestamps (file mtime, UTC), not new fetch times.

Used as the documented fallback, the same convention as the frozen cohort's CVE-2020-25213 (403) and CVE-2024-10924 (202).

cves.notes: There is no WPScan/Wordfence advisory text in this cohort because both hosts bot-block (403 / 202). Range provenance therefore rests on NVD + CVE.org (which agree: <= 1.3.7 affected) plus the package diff in experiments/topup-2026-10-17/fix-diff.md (fixed 1.3.8, filterChainFix). The NVD record itself only states 'up to, and including, 1.3.7'; the fixed version 1.3.8 comes from the 1.3.8 package (readme changelog + code diff), not from an advisory sentence. Recorded, not repaired.
